title: Best AI App for Stock Buy/Sell Signals?
author: PhysicalRelation6631
selftext:
Hi everyone,

I'm looking for a reliable AI trading app that analyzes stocks and sends real-time buy/sell alerts, including entry prices, profit targets, and stop-loss levels.
